definition: You.com is an artificial intelligence and search engine startup company.
details: The company was founded in 2020 by Richard Socher, the former chief scientist at Salesforce, and Bryan McCann, a former NLP researcher at Salesforce.

explainer.lead: You.com is an AI and search engine startup founded in 2020 by Richard Socher and Bryan McCann, both formerly of Salesforce. It pivoted in 2023 from consumer search toward AI tools.

tiers.eli5: It's a search company that added an AI chatbot so you can ask questions and get answers, not just links.
tiers.practitioner: It is a company and product, not an algorithm, so engineers interact with it as a search and chatbot platform. A pitfall is treating its answers as authoritative without checking sources.
tiers.paperLevel: No formal definition applies; it is a commercial AI and search platform, and its known limits are those of the underlying search and language models.

explainer.example: YouChat launched in December 2022, making You.com the first search engine to ship a large language model-based chatbot with live web results.
